draft.subject: Re: Search matching and the duplicate-project error
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for flagging both issues. On search: search is exact-match only today; partial-word matching is on the roadmap. Your report about the 500 error when duplicating a larger project is still open with us, and I'll make sure you get an update as soon as I have one.

In the meantime, the piece that tends to matter most early on is getting a second person in alongside you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
